summary.text: Nick Charles is a Democratic Maryland state senator from District 25 who was appointed in late 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Air Force veteran, he is president and chief executive officer of Charles Management Consulting Group and served in the House of Delegates from 2019 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Nick Charles was born in Washington, D.C., on December 16, 1982, and attended Largo High School.
He earned an associate degree in aviation management from the Community College of the Air Force in 2005 and a B.A. in business administration from the University of the District of Columbia in 2009.
Charles served in the U.S. Air Force from 2001 to 2006 and has been president and chief executive officer of Charles Management Consulting Group since 2015.
Charles represented District 25 in the Maryland House of Delegates from 2019 to 2023.
He was appointed to the Maryland State Senate to replace Melony Griffith and assumed office on December 6, 2023.
According to the General Assembly website, he serves on the Judicial Proceedings Committee.
